title.zh: 复制还是共享：零拷贝的吸引力
title.en: Copy or share: why zero-copy appeals

description.zh: DMA 整块复制有固定开销；一致地按行读，带宽由利特尔法则决定。用到的比例低于一个门槛时，多大的缓冲区都是共享快。
description.en: A DMA copy has a fixed cost; reading lines coherently gets the bandwidth Little's law allows. Below a threshold fraction, sharing wins at any buffer size.

title.zh: 一致性跨过一根线：家代理
title.en: Coherence across a link: the home agent

description.zh: 设备的缓存加入主机的一致性：每一行由主机的家代理管，设备要先问家，主机的核心要写时家通知设备作废。
description.en: A device's cache joins the host's coherence: the host's home agent owns every line, the device asks it first, and it tells the device to invalidate before a core writes.

title.zh: CXL 的三种协议和数据帧

description.zh: CXL.io、CXL.cache、CXL.mem 共用 PCIe 物理层；68 字节帧的槽位账决定一根 ×16 链路实际能搬多少。
description.en: CXL.io, CXL.cache and CXL.mem share the PCIe physical layer; the slot accounting of the 68-byte flit sets what a ×16 link really carries.

description.zh: 第 1 类只缓存（智能网卡），第 2 类缓存又带内存（GPU、FPGA），第 3 类只开放内存（内存扩展卡）；每一步动作对应哪些消息。
description.en: Type 1 only caches (smart NICs), Type 2 caches and has memory (GPUs, FPGAs), Type 3 only exposes memory (expansion cards); which messages each action costs.

title.zh: 内存扩展卡与冷热分层

description.zh: CXL 内存比本地慢一档：实测延迟和带宽，以及按页面热度把冷页放过去时平均延迟怎么变。
description.en: CXL memory is one step slower than local: measured latency and bandwidth, and how average latency moves when cold pages are placed there by popularity.

title.zh: 内存池与 CXL 交换机

description.zh: 几台主机合用一块内存能少备多少：统计复用，受需求相关性限制；多逻辑设备与交换机多一跳的代价。
description.en: How much less memory hosts need when they share a pool: statistical multiplexing limited by correlated demand; multi-logical devices and the cost of a switch hop.

title.zh: 背向作废：几台主机共用一行
title.en: Back-invalidate: several hosts sharing one line

description.zh: CXL 3.0 让内存设备自己维护目录，要作废其他主机的副本时发 BISnp；写得越多、主机越多，作废越多。
description.en: CXL 3.0 lets the memory device keep a directory and send BISnp to invalidate other hosts' copies; more writes and more hosts mean more invalidations.

description.zh: NVLink 4/5/6 每块 GPU 的带宽（换算成每个方向），NVSwitch 把 72 块 GPU 两两连通成一个 NVLink 域。
description.en: NVLink 4/5/6 bandwidth per GPU (converted to per direction), and how NVSwitch joins 72 GPUs into one NVLink domain.

description.zh: 归约分散加全收集，每块卡发出 2(N−1)/N 份数据，是带宽最优的；在真实链路上一次梯度同步要多久。
description.en: Reduce-scatter plus all-gather, each GPU sending 2(N−1)/N of the data, the bandwidth-optimal bound; how long one gradient sync takes on real links.

title.zh: 纵向扩展、横向扩展与 UALink

description.zh: 域内走 NVLink、域间走网络的两层全归约，域越大网络上的字节越少；UALink 1.0 是加速器之间的开放互连。
description.en: Two-level all-reduce, NVLink inside a domain and the network between them: bigger domains put fewer bytes on the network. UALink 1.0 is the open accelerator interconnect.

title.zh: 封装里的一致性：MI300A 与 Grace Hopper
title.en: Coherence in one package: MI300A and Grace Hopper

description.zh: MI300A 让 CPU 和 GPU 芯粒共用同一块 HBM3；Grace Hopper 用一致的 NVLink-C2C 连起两块各带内存的芯片。
description.en: MI300A lets CPU and GPU chiplets share one HBM3; Grace Hopper joins two chips with their own memory over coherent NVLink-C2C.

title.zh: 互连的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: CXL 4.0、UALink 2.0、Vera Rubin NVL72、800 Gb/s 网卡和共封装光学交换机：哪些已出货，哪些还在纸上。
description.en: CXL 4.0, UALink 2.0, Vera Rubin NVL72, 800 Gb/s NICs and co-packaged-optics switches: what ships and what is still on paper.

title.zh: 看一套互连的三个问题
title.en: Three questions to ask of an interconnect

description.zh: 共享的是什么，每个方向多少带宽、来回多少纳秒，一致性由谁保证、跨多大的范围。
description.en: What is shared, how much bandwidth per direction and how many nanoseconds per round trip, and who keeps it coherent over how wide a domain.
